name: Twolined spittlebug
desc: Twolined spittlebug (Prosapia bicincta): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Prosapia bicincta, the two-lined spittlebug, is a species of insect in the family Ischnorhinidae (formerly Cercopidae). Adults are black with two red or orange lines crossing the wings.
